project: Hybrid STFPM-for-grid + YOLO26/PatchCore-for-other-categories + DINOv2 + Temporal Transformer + PPO
dataset_location: MVTec AD data is not included in this repository; users must obtain it separately and follow its terms.
legacy_baseline: YOLO26 global embedding + Wide-ResNet PatchCore-style k-NN ensemble
subtype_classifier: dinov2_vits14 visual features + regularized LinearSVC; YOLO26 LinearSVC baseline included
score_calibration: Per-category empirical percentile against normal-only calibration references; not a defect probability.
temporal_input: Common routed score/local/global evidence fields and temporal score dynamics; STFPM-specific map features are not required for non-grid categories.
caveat: MVTec AD contains still images; temporal sequences are synthetic and not real-video deployment evidence.

artifact_distribution.pipeline_a_inference: Unavailable: no integrated Mahalanobis/Q-learning inference export is bundled.
artifact_distribution.ppo_checkpoint: Unavailable: no PPO checkpoint is bundled; the app uses its labeled adaptive video triage fallback.
